name: SE Ranking
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For SE Ranking, track an owned keyword set and combine it with user-supplied audit and backlink files. The hard boundary is large ranking data operation, competitive research, white-label reporting, and integrations, plus proprietary web index and data acquisition.
